title: Provider (parent record)
description: A provider is the parent record; its classified content lives in its offerings (see offering.schema.json). Unit of classification = service offering (project doc §7.1). The provider surfaces as the bundle of its offerings so compound needs stay visible.

contact.description: Email or phone. Informational only, never matched on.

geo.description: Two grains: precise WGS84 coordinate for the map + NUTS region code(s). GeoJSON (RFC 7946) uses [lon, lat] order when exported.

nuts.description: One or more NUTS codes at any level (e.g. DE300, DE40E, DE, FR). ISO 3166 alpha-2 acceptable for non-EU.

certifications_held.description: Credentials the provider holds. Strictly distinct from certification_scope on offerings (§7.3).

status.description: claimed = provider assertion; certified = attested by accreditation/notified body

source.description: URL or citation backing this entry

sources.description: Primary sources checked (URLs, Impressum, licence files)

notes.description: E.g. discrepancies found and how resolved — recorded, never silently fixed

offerings.description: Each offering carries exactly one D0 resource type. A provider spanning several types has several offerings.

status.description: Directory listings can outlive facilities. 'defunct' entries are retained for record but never shown in search results.
